description: The public agent identity rule, as a cross-repo fixture. Every implementation (wanxing facade/observer, paas runner/spine/web) runs this file. These are MEASURED values from the current implementation, not a specification of what it ought to be — a fixture that disagrees with reality would just make everyone edit code to match a wish. Change the fixture only by changing all implementations in the same breath.

cases.note: The canonical shape: leading slash stripped, upper case lowered, underscore preserved (it is an allowed character).
A space is a disallowed run of length 1 → one hyphen.
A RUN of disallowed characters collapses to ONE hyphen (the regex quantifier is greedy). Anyone 'tidying up' duplicate hyphens here breaks the contract in the opposite direction.

The other half of the same rule: a hyphen is an ALLOWED character, so it survives between two collapsed runs and accumulates. Fixture siblings `a//b` and `a - b` together pin the whole semantics; testing only one loses half of it.
The whole string is one disallowed run (non-ASCII is not allowed) → a single hyphen.
Non-ASCII between ASCII collapses to one hyphen.
Leading/trailing whitespace becomes a hyphen — only LEADING SLASHES are stripped, not other whitespace. Easy to 'fix' by accident.
Empty in, empty out — never throws.
All slashes are stripped by the leading-slash rule, leaving nothing.
Dots are allowed characters, so a traversal segment stays as dots (and cannot escape: the result is a flat slug).
Mixed: slash → hyphen, underscore preserved, all lowered.
